ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: 6/3/7/15/9/7. Ref. No. of Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation: 4-3/10/2020/MV/116. I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Acquisition of land for Moragahakanda/Kaluganga Development Project. Allotment of land depicted in sheet No. 01 in Block No. 02 in Cadastral Map No. 310226 seconded on 14.02.2025 by Surveyor General, situated in Nawaneliya village in Galporugolla Grama Niladhari Division No. E401A, in Naula Divisional Secretary's Division in Matale District in Central Province. 01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Maha Kumbura, Karakolagahamula Mukalana; Use of land at present:

Shrub Jungle; Claimed by State; Occupied by A. G. Leelawathi; Extent: 1.2140 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Use of land at present: Road (Old); Claimed by State; Extent: 0.0219 Hectare. All persons interested hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Naula Divisional Secretariat on 08th April, 2025 at 10.00 a.m. And are hereby requested to notify to me in writing with 2 copies on or before 03rd April, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. S. Vංඃൺඒൺ඄ඎආൺඋ, Divisional Secretary, Naula. Divisional Secretariat, Naula. 04th March, 2025 EOG 03 - 0157

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: 6/3/7/18. Ref. No. of Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation: 4-3/8/2018/PC/76. I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Public Purpose hereto mentioned is the Acquisition of land for use of Haduwa Kanishta Vidyalaya. Allotment of land depicted in sheet No. 01 in Block No. 02 in Cadastral Map No. 31190 seconded on 26.12.2024, situated in Haduwa Grama Niladhari Division No. E412C, in Naula Divisional Secretary's Division in Matale District in Central Province.

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Kolongollehena; Use of land at present: Watta; Claimed by A. M. K. G. Karunarathna Banda; Extent: 0.0743 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Naula Divisional Secretariat on 08th April, 2025 at 10.00 a.m. And are hereby requested to notify to me in writing with 2 copies on or before 03rd April, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
S. Vංඃൺඒൺ඄ඎආൺඋ, Divisional Secretary, Naula. At Divisional Secretariat, Naula. On this 06 the day of March, 2025 EOG 03 - 0158.
